name: KSeF (Krajowy System e-Faktur)

provenance.sourceText: documentation/docs/developer-guide/credentials-guide.md item 1: "KSeF | Poland | Already set. Token auth sunsets end-2026 -> certificate path later".

notes: Poland's OWN mandatory national clearance system, not a commercial vendor -- exactly one operator, the same reasoning 'chorus-pro' and 'sdi' hold. Mandatory rollout: 1 Feb 2026 for large taxpayers, 1 Apr 2026 for all other businesses, 1 Jan 2027 for 'digitally excluded' taxpayers (Act of 5 Aug 2025, Journal of Laws item 852).

offerings.description: Poland's own government e-invoicing platform, with a free test environment.

sandbox.notes: Free, instant test-environment access, no registration or company verification, fictitious NIP allowed (documentation/docs/developer-guide/credentials-guide.md item 1). Token generation for NEW tokens sunsets 31 Dec 2026; existing tokens stop working 1 Jan 2027 -- a certificate-based auth path will be needed before that cutover.
